content.short: VII Finance lets LPs borrow against Uniswap v4 positions while still earning fees and lending yield.
content.description: VII Finance is a credit-based market-making protocol: liquidity providers can borrow against their Uniswap v4 positions while those positions keep earning swap fees, lending yield and UNI rewards. That unlocks capital that would otherwise sit idle inside a liquidity position. It is deployed on Unichain.
